notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 a-b-c
notes.content: [p]**Patch a**[/p][p]- Balanced the English audio mix for cleaner sound.[/p][p]**Patch b**[/p][p]- Language selector in the Options menu now shows the correct language.[/p][p]- Controller selector appears the first time you open the menu (no more double-pause trick).[/p][p]**Patch c**[/p][p]- Collectible documents no longer conflict after opening the inventory, pause menu or To-Do list.[/p][p]- AI nerfed: reduced vision range, speed and FOV for easier gameplay.[/p][p]- Added 4 missing Kevin reactions; they now trigger properly.[/p][p]- Major respawn bug fixed: invisible wall removed.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steamfest - Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
[p]We are excited to present version 1.2.0 for the Steamfest!
This update includes many improvements and new content:[/p][list][*][p][b]AI[/b]: enhanced vision, logic and enemy behavior, making them more dangerous and reactive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hiding[/b]: ability to hide to avoid enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b]: improved sound design and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: various visual enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Props[/b]: new environmental elements for better world consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story[/b]: additional story content.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support and enjoy the Steamfest![/p]

notes.title: #1 - Update - The To do list version 1.1.13
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1.13 - Demo[/h1]

[b]What’s new in this version:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Expanded exterior[/b] : the house opens up even more! New windows now show the outside, with an additional neighborhood now visible.
[*] [b]Car event[/b] : a new interaction related to the car outside.
[*] [b]Cutscene polish[/b] : multiple improvements to the killer’s intro cutscene for smoother and more intense pacing.
[*] [b]Main menu rework[/b] : new lighting effects, improved layout, and clearer information.
[/list]
